title: Commercial Vehicle (CV) Policy (2024-25)
description: Regional Commercial Vehicle Credit Policy Norms as of August 2024 (DOC-2024-25)

rows.activeNorm: CAT A1 (Captive Large): ₹ 75L | CAT A2 (Captive Small): ₹ 35L or 1 veh | CAT B: ₹ 100L | CAT C: ₹ 75L | CAT D: ₹ 40L | CAT E (FTB): ₹ 35L or 1 veh | CAT F (FTU): ₹ 30L or 1 veh
rows.previousNorm: CAT A1: ₹ 50L | CAT A2: ₹ 25L (1 veh) | CAT B: ₹ 100L | CAT C: ₹ 60L | CAT D: ₹ 35L | CAT E: ₹ 30L (1 veh) | CAT F: ₹ 25L (1 veh)
rows.rationale: New vehicle cost inflation in past 2 years increased secondary market prices. Capping increased to ensure fast TAT and regional level approvals.

rows.activeNorm: CAT A1 (Captive Large): ₹ 40L | CAT A2 (Captive Small): ₹ 25L | CAT B: ₹ 100L | CAT C: ₹ 50L | CAT D: ₹ 35L | CAT E: ₹ 25L or 1 veh | CAT F: ₹ 22L or 1 veh

rows.rationale: Enhanced regional capping to accommodate commercial vehicle price escalation and improve turnaround time.

rows.previousNorm: CAT A1: ₹ 25L | CAT A2: ₹ 12L (1 veh) | CAT B: ₹ 50L | CAT C: ₹ 25L | CAT D: ₹ 18L | CAT E: ₹ 12L (1 veh) | CAT F: ₹ 10L (1 veh)
rows.rationale: Adjusted funding limits for SCV category across Small/Medium fleet operators.

rows.activeNorm: CAT A1 (Captive Large): ₹ 60L | CAT A2 (Captive Small): ₹ 35L or 1 veh | CAT B: ₹ 100L | CAT C: ₹ 60L | CAT D: ₹ 45L or 1 veh | CAT E: ₹ 30L or 1 veh
rows.previousNorm: CAT A1: ₹ 50L | CAT A2: ₹ 25L (1 veh) | CAT B: ₹ 100L | CAT C: ₹ 50L | CAT D: ₹ 35L (1 veh) | CAT E: ₹ 25L (1 veh)
rows.rationale: Tipper price escalation addressed with higher regional approval caps.

rows.parameter: Max Funding: School / College Bus (New LCV Bus)
rows.activeNorm: Category A (>1000 Students): ₹ 100 Lacs | Category B (500-1000 Students): ₹ 75 Lacs | Category C (<500 Students): ₹ 30 Lacs or 1 Bus
rows.previousNorm: Category A: ₹ 100L | Category B: ₹ 50L | Category C: ₹ 20L or 1 Bus
rows.rationale: Expanded funding support for educational institutions and student fleet transport.

rows.parameter: Max Funding: Commercial Bus (HCV, LCV, SCV - Non-School)
rows.activeNorm: CAT B: ₹ 100 Lacs | CAT C: ₹ 80 Lacs | CAT D: ₹ 40 Lacs | CAT E: ₹ 35 Lacs or 1 Bus
rows.previousNorm: CAT B: ₹ 100L | CAT C: ₹ 75L | CAT D: ₹ 35L | CAT E: ₹ 30L or 1 Bus
rows.rationale: Enhanced fleet funding for intercity and route permit bus operators.

rows.parameter: Fast Track Tatkal Screen (Used CV Funding)
rows.activeNorm:
• No funding on Trailers under Tatkal
• Tippers up to 28 Tons only: Max ₹ 25 Lacs
• ICV funding restricted to 12 Ton segment: Max ₹ 15 Lacs
• LTV: CAT E = 75%, CAT F = 70%
• External Guarantor with property ownership acceptable
rows.previousNorm: ₹ 20L on Trailers/M&HCV/Tippers, ₹ 15L on LCV/ICV; LTV: CAT E = 70%, CAT F = 65%
rows.rationale: Risk mitigation on heavy trailers and high-tonnage tippers under Tatkal expedited scheme.

rows.parameter: Fast Track Tatkal Eligibility & LTV Booster
rows.activeNorm: CIBIL Score > 730 + Property ownership as per norms + Property Market Value >= 2 times of loan amount.
rows.previousNorm: 5% Additional LTV if any one of conditions satisfied for FTB/FTU.
rows.rationale: Quality customer onboarding under Tatkal program.

rows.parameter: Approval Authority: Branch Level (BCM + Branch Head)
rows.activeNorm: New & Used: Up to ₹ 100 Lacs (Recommended by Branch Credit Manager & Approved by Branch Head)
rows.rationale: Exposure approval @ Branch Level only for better TAT and customer service.

rows.parameter: Approval Authority: Regional Level (RCM + Regional Head)
rows.activeNorm: Nil (Decentralized to Branch Head up to ₹ 100 Lacs)
rows.rationale: Streamlined approval matrix and reduction in regional TAT bottlenecks.

rows.activeNorm: Only Regions with overall Delinquency < 15% are eligible. Bureau score: 450 - 549. Max funding: ₹ 25 Lacs.
rows.previousNorm: CIBIL score < 670 and > 450 under Sahaj. Bureau score: 450 - 549. Max: ₹ 25 Lacs.
rows.rationale: Incentive for branches to maintain delinquency below 15% and strict portfolio risk control.

rows.parameter: Tipper LTV Norms (> 10 Year Old Vehicles)
rows.activeNorm: For > 10 year old tippers at time of funding: CAT A2 = 70% | CAT D = 80% | CAT E = 73%
rows.previousNorm: CAT A2 = 75% | CAT D = 85% | CAT E = 78%
rows.rationale: Mitigate asset risk and depreciation on older tipper models.

rows.parameter: Retail School Bus: Eligible Asset Range
rows.activeNorm: HCV Buses included (alongside all LCV & SCV types)
rows.previousNorm: All LCV and SCV types only
rows.rationale: To increase the scope of getting new institutional school bus customers.

rows.activeNorm:
• Branch Category A: 15 Nos / ₹ 100 Lacs (whichever earlier)
• Branch Category B: 12 Nos / ₹ 75 Lacs (whichever earlier)
• Branch Category C: 10 Nos / ₹ 50 Lacs (whichever earlier)
rows.previousNorm: Branch A: 10 Nos / ₹ 75L | Branch B: 7 Nos / ₹ 50L | Branch C: 5 Nos / ₹ 30L
rows.rationale: Potential to increase overall business sourcing volume.

rows.activeNorm: To be considered on LOWER of Grid / Valuation and Purchase Cost.
rows.previousNorm: To be considered on lower of Grid / Valuation.
rows.rationale: Prudent risk management and preventing asset over-invoicing.

rows.activeNorm: For funding up to ₹ 8.00 Lakhs, electricity bill can be accepted as property proof.
rows.previousNorm: For funding up to ₹ 5.00 Lakhs, electricity bill can be accepted.
rows.rationale: Simplified documentation benchmark for loans up to ₹ 8 Lakhs.

rows.activeNorm:
Bureau default must be cleared and mitigated by ANY ONE of:
1. 10% lower LTV
2. External Guarantor with property value > loan amount
3. 20% IRR
4. House/commercial property ownership in applicant/co-app name equal to 2x loan amount
5. Vehicle collateral equivalent to loan amount
rows.previousNorm: Overdue to be cleared and proof to be documented.
rows.rationale: Stricter risk mitigation framework for CIBIL overdue observations.

rows.activeNorm:
• Level 1: Good resale & widely used
• Level 2: Moderate resale & usage (LTV cut by 5%)
• Level 3: Low resale / specialized usage (LTV cut by 10%; CAT A-Small, CAT E, CAT F NOT eligible; CAT D eligible only with existing Level 3 ownership)
• LTV cuts not applicable to CAT A-Large & CAT B
• Unlisted models default to Level 3
rows.rationale: To ensure controlled exposure on high-liquidity vs specialized qualitative assets.

rows.activeNorm: Limit is capped at ₹ 500 Lacs (₹ 5.00 Crores)
rows.rationale: Accommodating corporate DSAs operating across multiple States.

sections.title: 1. Policy Amendment Identification
sections.summary: Regional Commercial Vehicle Credit Policy Norms — DOC-2024-25 (Effective August 2024).
items: Scope: Full credit parameters for M&HCV, LCV, SCV, Tippers, Commercial Buses, and School Buses.
Branch Delegation: Approval authority up to ₹ 100 Lacs delegated directly to Branch Credit Manager & Branch Head.
Corporate DSA Capping: Expanded to ₹ 500 Lacs across multi-state sourcing partners.

sections.title: 2. Asset Level Categorisation & Underwriting Cuts
sections.summary: Risk classification of vehicle assets based on secondary market liquidity and demand:
items: Level 1 Asset: High liquidity & wide market demand (Standard LTV).
Level 2 Asset: Moderate resale value & usage (5% LTV reduction applied).
Level 3 Asset: Low resale / specialized application (10% LTV reduction; CAT A-Small, CAT E, CAT F barred; CAT D requires prior ownership).
LTV cuts for Level 2 & 3 are waived for CAT A (Large) and CAT B clients.
Any unlisted vehicle model defaults to Level 3 classification.

sections.title: 3. Credit Bureau (CIBIL) Default Mitigation Rules
sections.summary: Mandatory mitigation options if default/overdue appears in applicant bureau report:
items: Option A: 10% reduction in applicable LTV norm.
Option B: External Guarantor with property value exceeding proposed loan amount.
Option C: Price loan at 20% minimum IRR.
Option D: Owned residential/commercial property in applicant/co-app name valued at >= 2x loan amount.
Option E: Additional vehicle collateral equal to loan amount.
